blurb: Great River Golf Club offers a championship-style golf course, golf lessons through a Golf Academy, and private event spaces for weddings, corporate events, and golf outings. The club provides professional event planning services and a restaurant with waterfront dining. They serve the Milford, CT area and nearby communities.
